calls.title: Voyage Prive<>GrowthBook - Event Forwarder Discussion
calls.summary: The call discussed GrowthBook's event forwarder feature for sending experiment assignment logs to BigQuery, but the team (Lucas Wolff and Kamal Ahmed from Voyage Prive) concluded their existing Snowplow setup is sufficient, so no change is needed. Key participants were Lucas and Kamal (prospective buyers), Jake Heier (GrowthBook sales), and Jeremy (GrowthBook co-founder). Next steps: Jake will send a detailed pricing breakdown for a 15-user plan (cloud vs. self-hosted), and the team will continue evaluating GrowthBook versus Statsig, with a decision expected within the next week.
